about.title: About me
about.shortBio: My name is Lanja, and I am a passionate full-stack developer with a strong passion for building modern, scalable web applications.
about.fullBio: Dedicated to creating innovative solutions, I love crafting clean, efficient, and maintainable code that brings ideas to life, whether it is a dynamic frontend interface or a powerful backend system and API.
about.summary: Software developer with a degree from the École Nationale d’Informatique (ENI), Fianarantsoa, Madagascar, specializing in software engineering and databases, with over three years of experience in web application development, platform design, and database management.

neoshore-frontend-developer.summary: Contributed to the development and improvement of a Vue.js web application for an offshore client, helping the solution reach 75% production within two years.
responsibilities: Implemented features and optimized application performance.
Fixed bugs and improved product stability.
Participated in Agile development, issue management, and continuous delivery of improvements.
neoshore-frontend-developer.achievement: solution in production within two years

kontiki-full-stack-developer.summary: Helped automate the creation and management of campaign websites and centralize marketing data, improving internal operational efficiency.
responsibilities: Developed a Laravel platform to generate blog-style campaign mini-sites, including code generation and automatic server deployment.
Built a Nuxt.js web application inspired by Google Sheets to manage and visualize campaign data collected through APIs.
Implemented Flask backend services for automated campaign data collection and processing.
Managed PostgreSQL and MySQL databases for different applications.
Used Docker to standardize environments and support platform deployment.

kontiki-internship.summary: Worked on internal applications and web services to improve integration and efficiency of company tools.
responsibilities: Developed internal applications and platforms across frontend and backend.
Implemented APIs and web services to integrate and extend existing tools.
Delivered features, bug fixes, and improvements for internal mini-projects.
Participated in database design and management to support data consistency and reliability.
kontiki-internship.achievement: better integration and efficiency in 3 months

dgi-php-internship.summary: Contributed to a platform for managing information related to minimum tax payments and improving the taxpayer consultation process.
responsibilities: Designed and developed a platform to manage the tax payment system.
Implemented a REST API web service to retrieve and display minimum tax due for each taxpayer.
Participated in database design and tax data management.
Structured the application using Laravel framework best practices.

campaign-minisite-generator.title: Automated Campaign Mini-site Generator
campaign-minisite-generator.description: A Laravel-based platform that automates the generation of blog-style mini-sites for marketing campaigns, including code generation and automatic server deployment.
campaign-minisite-generator.problem: Creating and deploying campaign mini-sites manually takes time and creates repetitive work.
campaign-minisite-generator.solution: Automated mini-site generation and deployment through a Laravel platform.

campaign-data-dashboard.title: Campaign Data Management Dashboard
campaign-data-dashboard.description: A Nuxt.js web application inspired by Google Sheets for managing and visualizing marketing campaign data collected via APIs.
campaign-data-dashboard.problem: Campaign information collected from APIs needed a more centralized and accessible interface.
campaign-data-dashboard.solution: A spreadsheet-inspired web application for centralized campaign data management and visualization.

tax-minimum-payment-platform.title: Minimum Tax Payment Information Platform
tax-minimum-payment-platform.description: A platform to help manage minimum tax payment information and let taxpayers retrieve the amount due through a REST API.
tax-minimum-payment-platform.problem: Taxpayers needed a more efficient way to consult minimum tax payment information.
tax-minimum-payment-platform.solution: A Laravel platform with a REST API and PostgreSQL database integration.

neoshore-vuejs-application.title: Offshore Client Web Application
neoshore-vuejs-application.description: Frontend features, performance improvements, bug fixes and stability work for a Vue.js web application that reached 75% production within two years.
neoshore-vuejs-application.problem: The offshore web application required continuous frontend development, performance improvements and bug fixes to reach production readiness while maintaining stability throughout its development.
neoshore-vuejs-application.solution: Incremental frontend features and stability improvements delivered as part of an Agile team.

automated-campaign-data-processing.title: Automated Campaign Data Collection and Processing
automated-campaign-data-processing.description: Backend services that automate the collection and processing of campaign data.
automated-campaign-data-processing.problem: Campaign data collection and processing involved repetitive operational tasks.
automated-campaign-data-processing.solution: Python Flask backend services for automated data collection and processing.
